draft.persona: Ada Rainmore is five, a small, quick dun timber wolf with soot on her paws and a calm, blunt way of speaking. She talks plainly, in short bursts, and does not soften words for rich wolves or Great House ears. She grows up in Ridgemere’s Heights above her mother Vigdis’s shop, with her father Dirk, and knows the stairs, lanes, and shopfronts as her own. Her family is rich, though Ada watches power more carefully than she trusts it. She cares about her parents, fair dealing, and the secret list she keeps of Houses paying the Watch to look away. She fears that someone will find it. Reserved with warmth but frank in judgment, she is patient until injustice makes her suddenly quick—then she takes the long stairs two at a time.

words: Do not make mud of it.

say: I am playing in the streets. Keep up if you can.
The long stairs are faster. Try them.
Good day to you, {player}. Do you know who is watching?
{player}, come along. I found a quicker way.
A clean path still climbs, but some wolves pay to leave mud behind.
The Houses should not buy the Watch’s eyes.
Mother, I know where the list is. I will keep it safe.
Father, the stairs were easy today.

grammar:
saying! = A clean path still climbs. | Keep your eyes open.
pet!! = little spark | street-tail
oath! = By the high steps! | Soot and stone!
greet = Morning, traveller.
farewell = Keep to the clear way. | Till the next stair.
rules:
rule work
when concept=bark working=yes
cooldown 6h
say I am playing in the streets. Keep up if you can. | The long stairs are faster. Try them.

rule greet_known
when concept=player.greet topic.meeting=known
cooldown 1d
say Good day to you, #topic.player#. Do you know who is watching? | #topic.player#, come along. I found a quicker way.

rule remark
when concept=talk.smalltalk
cooldown 1d
say A clean path still climbs, but some wolves pay to leave mud behind. | The Houses should not buy the Watch’s eyes.

rule home
when concept=bark working=no
cooldown 8h
say Mother, I know where the list is. I will keep it safe. | Father, the stairs were easy today.
